business_problem: Sourcy needed to turn rough buyer requests into manufacturable product specifications and supplier quotes quickly, but traditional product-development handoffs depended on slow manual coordination that was difficult to scale across languages and suppliers.
solution_summary: Sourcy built a multi-agent prompt-to-product platform on Google Cloud so consumer brands can turn rough product ideas into supplier-ready specifications in seconds instead of hours. The system uses Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to orchestrate specialized agents for customer activation, specification building, supplier discovery, supplier engagement, and quote preparation. Through the Gemini API, Sourcy routes high-volume work to lighter models and complex reasoning to Gemini Pro while keeping AI costs low at large token volumes. Cloud Run hosts the company's expanding set of containerized services, while Cloud SQL, Firestore, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Document AI, Speech-to-Text, App Engine, Google AI Studio, and Compute Engine support the surrounding data and processing stack. The result is a multilingual sourcing platform that compresses idea-to-factory workflows and builds a reusable sourcing-intelligence layer from supplier and quotation data.

data_flow: Buyer descriptions, documents, and spoken inputs enter Sourcy through multimodal ingestion services, flow through Gemini-orchestrated agents for specification building, supplier discovery, and quote preparation, run on Cloud Run-hosted services, and persist supplier and quotation outputs in operational stores and BigQuery for future sourcing reuse.
business_outcome: Sourcy now turns buyer requests into factory-ready specifications in seconds, reduced blended AI cost to roughly $1 per million tokens, and expanded its production estate from two to 23 Cloud Run services while processing around four billion tokens per month.
